name: Patricia Brown
original_name: パトリシア・ブラウン
source:
A foreigner studying abroad in Japan as a newly-appointed English teacher.
Her honest and transparent character allows her to disregard the relationship of student and teacher and make friends with anyone.

Due to a certain incident, she falls in love with Narumi at first sight and, as a show of how unpredictable she is, immediately starts engaging in sexual relations with him. She is admittedly lecherous, but not vulgar or lewd, and only engages in such activities with those she is comfortable with.
 
This high-octane girl is the reason Mitama and Aya are spurred into action.

[translated and modified from [url=http://www.astronauts.co.jp/comet/koreuba/c03.html]official website[/url]]
